body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #80 (V1-0007): CCF-V1-002 pins `genesis-inventory/0.1-experimental` for two Core verbs.
title: genesis: profile identifiers still contain `0.1-experimental` for Core init and adopt
